system.description:
It is said that dread Shaitan himself forged the ranks of the first followers of Baal from Cainites of other lineages he could sway to his side, and the practice continues to this day: a substantial minority of the Baali are not Baali by blood at all, but stem from an adopted parentage — converts to the Baali banner. Characters with this Merit either began their unlives as descendants of other blood, later converting to the Baali creed, or are of sufficiently close descent from such a convert to maintain some link to her ancestral clan affinities. Apostates may replace either Obfuscate or Presence with any one Discipline appropriate to her ancestral clan (Daimoinon is innate and cannot be replaced), and can pass with relative ease for members of other clans — though a determined effort will still root out an Apostate.

The one drawback to this Merit is political: Apostate Baali are forever barred from leadership roles in the bloodline because of their "inferior" blood.
system.source: Clanbook: Baali, Chapter Three: Descent into Darkness
